statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, len(r) = m and for every i with 0 <= i < m, r[i] = treeDist(a_i, b_i) + 1. Here depth(x), for x >= 1, is the unique d >= 0 with 2^d <= x < 2^(d+1); u is an ancestor of v if u = floor(v / 2^k) for some k >= 0; lca(a,b) is the common ancestor of a and b of maximum depth; and treeDist(a,b) = depth(a) + depth(b) - 2*depth(lca(a,b)), which is the number of edges on the unique simple path between a and b in the complete binary tree with nodes {1,...,2^n - 1} and parent of x > 1 equal to floor(x/2).
preconditions: Let m = len(queries). Assume 2 <= n <= 30, 1 <= m <= 100000, and for every i with 0 <= i < m: queries[i] has length 2; writing a_i = queries[i][0] and b_i = queries[i][1], we have 1 <= a_i <= 2^n - 1, 1 <= b_i <= 2^n - 1, and a_i != b_i.
